arguments.command:
python3 - << 'PY'
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W, H = 900, 480
bg = (20,20,20)
fg = (230,230,230)
img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), color=bg)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font = ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf', 28)
except IOError:
    font = ImageFont.load_default()
text_lines = [
    'Settings – Linux (Cassette selected)',
    '',
    'LOOK',
    '  screen: Cassette',
    '  color scheme: Tape Mono',
    '  text size: 100%',
    '  haptics: on',
]
# compute starting y
x = 40
y = 40
for line in text_lines:
    d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=fg)
    y += 40
img_path = '/workspace/settings_region_cassette_linux.png'
img.save(img_path)
print('Saved to', img_path)
PY
